summary: Phase 6 / S4 Controller UI and operator guides for backup repositories, Back up now and restore-as-new.

guide.reason: Adds operator workflows for NFS backup repository setup, stopped Back up now and restore-as-new, and updates console navigation for the S4 screens.

api.reason: UI calls the Controller backup relay that landed mid-flight in the same worktree: GET/POST /api/v1/pools/{id}/backup-repositories, POST .../backup-repositories/{repo_id}/test, GET .../backup-catalog, POST /api/v1/vms/{id}/backup, POST /api/v1/pools/{id}/backup-restore. Create uses flat {request_id,id?,name,kind,source}; restore requires host_id. Docs/API.md and openapi.json for that relay are assessed with those Controller paths; Core-local contracts remain in the S4 Core change record.

roadmap.reason: S4 UI/guide only; Phase 6 gate and public roadmap remain open until Core lab evidence and later slices close.

state.record: Master pool-backup-repositories.json, pool-backup-catalog/ and pool-backup-runs/ plus repository recovery-point directories. Fresh Controller adopts repositories and catalog from authenticated master inventory when backup_*_reported flags are true; UI only submits requests and renders host-reported results.
state.reason: Pool backup destinations and recovery points are Core-owned; Controller must not keep the only copy.
